paper.title: Combinatorial Genetics Reveals a Scaling Law for the Effects of Mutations on Splicing
paper.supplied_bibliography_errors: Crossref confirms the supplied title and author list (Pablo Baeza-Centurion, Belén Miñana, Jörn M. Schmiedel, Juan Valcárcel, Ben Lehner), journal Cell, volume 176, issue 3, and year 2019. The supplied page span 549--563 is abbreviated; Crossref records 549-563.e23. No author-list error was found for this entry.

sources.what: Publisher API response; core metadata only, not full text
Supplementary data workbook, including the combinatorially complete genotype table

overlaps.locator: Results, 'Combinatorially Complete Mapping of a Genotype Space'; Figure 1B
overlaps.definition_quote: 10 positions can have 2 different nt and one can have 3 different nt
overlaps.definition_divergence: The article counts the designed genotypes in the complete FAS library; GraphFLA n_configs counts unique configurations in the built landscape. The publisher supplementary dataset contains the full matching genotype set.

input.preprocessing: None; pos1..pos11 and fitness passed as-is. The compact sequence codes and fitness values were cross-checked against the publisher's supplementary genotype table and Mean.PSI field.

overlaps.reason: The local input contains the same complete genotype set as the publisher's supplementary workbook.

overlaps.locator: Results, 'Reconstructing the Evolution of FAS Exon 6'; Figures 1A, 1B, and S1B
overlaps.definition_divergence: The paper's variable nucleotide positions map one-to-one to the 11 position columns supplied to DNALandscape.

input.preprocessing: None; pos1..pos11 used as the configuration variables.

overlaps.locator: Results, 'Combinatorially Complete Mapping of a Genotype Space'; Figure 1D
overlaps.definition_divergence: The article characterizes the PSI distribution by modality and threshold shares. GraphFLA fitness_distribution returns unitless moments and ratios such as skewness, kurtosis, and coefficient of variation; these are not the same reported statistic.

input.preprocessing: None; fitness used as provided and verified against supplementary Mean.PSI.

overlaps.graphfla_call: Not run; no like-for-like published value for GraphFLA fitness_distribution.
overlaps.reason: Modality and threshold percentages are not GraphFLA's published distribution outputs.

overlaps.locator: Results, 'Mutations Have Non-independent Effects on Splicing' and 'Non-linear Scaling of Mutation Effects as a Function of the Starting PSI'; Equation 2
overlaps.definition_divergence: This is a conceptual overlap: the paper studies mutation-effect variation across genetic contexts, while its scaling-law parameter A is a per-mutation model parameter rather than a published global idiosyncratic index. The GraphFLA metric is under review, so equivalence is unknown.

input.preprocessing: None; fitness used as provided and verified against supplementary Mean.PSI.

overlaps.graphfla_call: Not run; no paper-level global idiosyncratic-index value to compare.
overlaps.reason: The paper does not report a scalar matching this index; GraphFLA's global idiosyncratic-index definition is under review.

overlaps.locator: STAR Methods, 'Simulated biallelic genotype landscape and phantom interactions'; Figure S5E
overlaps.definition_divergence: The paper describes truncating Walsh-Hadamard coefficients and plotting RMSE for a simulated landscape. GraphFLA higher_order_epistasis returns an R-squared from polynomial regression on the measured landscape; these are different statistics.
overlaps.graphfla_call: Not run; Figure S5E values are plotted and are not reproduction targets.
overlaps.reason: No printed variance-explained-by-order value was reported, and plot values were not read.

blockers.why: Direct Cell/ScienceDirect PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403. The Elsevier text API returned HTTP 200 but only a core-metadata XML response, saved in the dossier. The publisher's indexed article page was accessible for review.
blockers.needed_for: Local archival copy only; the publisher article page and supplementary files were sufficient for the reported comparisons.

verdict_reason: The printed genotype-space structure gives exact targets for GraphFLA's configuration and variable counts. The paper's main splicing-scaling, model-fit, and plotted higher-order results do not provide like-for-like GraphFLA metrics.
